summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload in a Vue UI component package
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `@bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (`WV8StW` over the constant table `n7gIxM`) and an alphabet-substitution decoder (`hc1jfK9`) with mangled identifiers, so the executed behavior is not readable from source. The package presents itself as a Vue CLI UI component library (`external-steps-ui`, `main: lib/cjs/index.js`), which has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or execution of a large opaque payload at install time. Using Bun as the interpreter causes the payload to run outside Node and evades Node-based install-time analyzers. Purpose mismatch, obfuscation, and alternate-runtime execution together indicate an install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
